properties.description: Strategy 2 (Prod -> Lower Environment Synchronization): looks up ConfigurationId in mig.SyncConfiguration (Prd server), which specifies a single TargetEnvironment and a SyncStrategy (UPSERT_ALL, INSERT_ALL, UPSERT_ENV_SPECIFIC, or INSERT_ENV_SPECIFIC). Builds the Production source query accordingly (unfiltered for the *_ALL strategies; filtered to TargetEnvironment via EnvironmentColumn for the *_ENV_SPECIFIC strategies; additionally excluding rows whose BusinessKeyColumns already exist in the target table for the INSERT_* strategies). Before copying, checks the Production source for duplicate BusinessKeyColumns and blocks the sync if any are found. If clean, writes the result into the matching lower-environment table (Dev/Test/Acc) via an AzureSqlSink Copy Activity (writeBehavior upsert for the UPSERT_* strategies, insert for the INSERT_* strategies), then checks the target table for duplicate BusinessKeyColumns after the write and fails the sync if any are found. Logs the outcome to mig.SyncRun. Reuses the existing linked services/datasets from ../../adf (LS_ProdSqlMig, LS_SourceSqlMig_Dev/Test/Acc, DS_StagingTableMig, DS_SourceTableMig_Dev/Test/Acc). See Synchronise/README.md.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT SourceSchema, SourceTable, TargetSchema, TargetTable, EnvironmentColumn, SyncStrategy, BusinessKeyColumns FROM mig.SyncConfiguration WHERE SyncConfigurationId = @{pipeline().parameters.ConfigurationId} AND IsActive = 1;

DECLARE @Id BIGINT; INSERT INTO mig.SyncRun (SyncConfigurationId, TargetEnvironment, BatchId, SyncStatus) VALUES (@{pipeline().parameters.ConfigurationId}, '@{pipeline().parameters.TargetEnvironment}', '@{variables('BatchId')}', 'RUNNING'); SET @Id = SCOPE_IDENTITY(); SELECT @Id AS SyncRunId;

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns, ', COUNT(*) AS DupCount FROM (', if(contains(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SyncStrategy, 'ENV_SPECIFIC'), concat('SELECT * FROM ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceSchema, '.', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceTable, ' WHERE ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.EnvironmentColumn, ' = ''', pipeline().parameters.TargetEnvironment, ''''), concat('SELECT * FROM ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceSchema, '.', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceTable)), ') src GROUP BY ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns, ' HAVING COUNT(*) > 1')

source.sqlReaderQuery: UPDATE mig.SyncRun SET SyncStatus = 'ERROR', ErrorMessage = 'Duplicate business key(s) found in Production source (BusinessKeyColumns) before upsert; sync blocked.', CompletedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE SyncRunId = @{activity('InsertSyncRunRunning').output.firstRow.SyncRunId}; SELECT 1 AS Done;

message.value: @concat('Sync blocked for ConfigurationId ', string(pipeline().parameters.ConfigurationId), ' -> ', pipeline().parameters.TargetEnvironment, ': duplicate business key(s) found in Production source before upsert. See mig.SyncRun for the audited error.')

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT ISNULL(STRING_AGG(CHAR(39) + REPLACE(CAST(', if(greater(length(split(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns, ',')), 1), concat('CONCAT(', join(split(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns, ','), ', CHAR(124), '), ')'), activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns), ' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), CHAR(39), CHAR(39)+CHAR(39)) + CHAR(39), '',''), CHAR(39) + ''__NONE__'' + CHAR(39)) AS ExistingKeysCsv FROM ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.TargetSchema, '.', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.TargetTable)

@if(startsWith(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SyncStrategy, 'INSERT_'), if(contains(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SyncStrategy, 'ENV_SPECIFIC'), concat('SELECT * FROM ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceSchema, '.', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceTable, ' WHERE ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.EnvironmentColumn, ' = ''', pipeline().parameters.TargetEnvironment, ''' AND ', if(greater(length(split(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns, ',')), 1), concat('CONCAT(', join(split(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns, ','), ', CHAR(124), '), ')'), activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns), ' NOT IN (', activity('GetExistingTargetKeysDev').output.firstRow.ExistingKeysCsv, ')'), concat('SELECT * FROM ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceSchema, '.', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceTable, ' WHERE ', if(greater(length(split(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns, ',')), 1), concat('CONCAT(', join(split(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns, ','), ', CHAR(124), '), ')'), activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns), ' NOT IN (', activity('GetExistingTargetKeysDev').output.firstRow.ExistingKeysCsv, ')')), if(contains(activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SyncStrategy, 'ENV_SPECIFIC'), concat('SELECT * FROM ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceSchema, '.', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceTable, ' WHERE ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.EnvironmentColumn, ' = ''', pipeline().parameters.TargetEnvironment, ''''), concat('SELECT * FROM ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceSchema, '.', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.SourceTable)))

@concat('IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.TargetSchema, '.', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.TargetTable, ' GROUP BY ', activity('GetSyncConfiguration').output.firstRow.BusinessKeyColumns, ' HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) THROW 51000, ''Duplicate business key(s) found in the Dev target table after upsert. source.sqlReaderQuery: UPDATE mig.SyncRun SET SyncStatus = 'SUCCESS', CompletedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE SyncRunId = @{activity('InsertSyncRunRunning').output.firstRow.SyncRunId}; SELECT 1 AS Done;

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('UPDATE mig.SyncRun SET SyncStatus = ''ERROR'', ErrorMessage = ''', replace(string(activity('SwitchTargetEnvironment').Error.message), '''', ''''''), ''', CompletedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE SyncRunId = ', string(activity('InsertSyncRunRunning').output.firstRow.SyncRunId), '; SELECT 1 AS Done;')
